sfx_review.note: After the line has settled; matches the regular percussive streaks of the music bed.

pattern.description: Centered headline builds word by word: 'All hype.' appears first, then 'No', then 'performance.'; the centered line reflows left as each word is appended so it stays centred.
pattern.why_premium: Each word arrives on a quick beat and the whole line glides to stay optically centred, so the punchline builds rhythmically without the text ever jumping off-centre.

build_hint.gsap: Split into words; set all autoAlpha 0. Timeline: gsap.to(['.w-all', '.w-hype'], {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.15}); then gsap.to('.w-no', {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.12}, '+=0.1'); gsap.to('.w-performance', {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.12}, '+=0.1'); animate the line wrapper x to keep the visible words centred with ease 'power2.out' (or use Flip on the inline layout).
build_hint.remotion: Per-word opacity via interpolate(frame, [start, start+4], [0, 1]) with ~3-5 frame offsets; container translateX = interpolate of measured visible-width/2 through a non-overshooting spring({damping: 200}) so the line recentres smoothly.

notes: camera.move none; the scale 0.8988 / pan_x reflect the line reflowing as words append, not a camera move. 'All' and 'hype.' appear in the same filmstrip frame, so they may be one unit. The visual text leads the narrated 'All hype,' (61.29s) slightly.
